scope: Local Linux codegen and input-section placement experiment; actual GNU SDK layout, correctness and runtime are unmeasured. No device or Oracle access.

map_relink.purpose: Local map-only relink to inspect whether LLD places unique hot input sections. No measurement or SDK claim.

limits: These are static complete emitted ranges, not the earlier 531 sampled address bins, cache misses or a simultaneous working set.
Local rust-lld keeps unique hot input sections dispersed. Actual GNU SDK map must independently prove grouping before timing selection.
Common input section is unselected because it couples GC and loses individual map attribution.
Unique input-section labels are section names, not inferred mangled function identities. Actual SDK audit/budgets/gates remain required.
